items.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018
items.q: I did my first swing dance with Earl May with the great bass player Earl May.

ctx.x: Do you have an observation about why that is?

Well the only — I’ve done one. I did one jazz party. There’s a big — I don’t know what the word is, but there’s a big gap between traditional jazz and modern jazz. And most people in the traditional scene are white from what I can gather. And so, and then the modern jazz scene, or I won’t even say that, the bebop scene forward is a lot more mixed culturally. And I wonder why that is. I wonder why, because I certainly love swing and blues and Louis Armstrong and knowing where Bird and Diz came from and learning…
